answer: Make each identity post a stake that can be slashed, and let peers trace who vouched for whom. Picture the trust graph as a web where every vertex is an agent and every thread is a signed vouch. A sybil cluster shows up as a dense knot hanging off a single thread to the honest web, so its weight is capped by that one cut edge. Stake carved in marble, not chalk, means a caught ring loses real funds, so faking many vertices costs more than it pays.
